bounds.domain: Five ordered entries, two newest retained entries, a three-entry batch threshold, two symbolic log classes, three monotone clock epochs and one fallback response.
assumptions: The clock abstracts a warning within or outside the existing 60-second lookback. Entry classification, appending and eviction are synchronous. The real HTTP/logging hook checks the production warning classifier and actual chat fallback.

ReplySettles assumes weak fairness of reply once a request exists. ReplyWithoutFairness intentionally has a stuttering counterexample. This does not prove HTTP scheduling, elapsed-time accuracy, disk-log retention or implementation refinement.
